C. Subarrays
time limit per test
2 seconds
memory limit per test
256 megabytes
input
standard input
output
standard output

You are given an array $$$a$$$ of $$$n$$$ integers and an integer $$$k$$$. Count subarrays whose sum is at most $$$10^9$$$.

Formally, find the number of pairs $$$(l, r)$$$ such that

$$$$$$\sum_{i=l}^{r} a_i \le k.$$$$$$

Input

The first line contains $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases. The sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$. Use e.g. fast input.

  • first
  • second
Output

For each test case print one integer.

Example
Input
Copy
3
5 2
2 1 3 1 4
Output
2
Note

In the first test, the answer is $$$2$$$.
